notes: Reached via Chrome connector, no proxy needed (robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow; standard User-agent:* policy explicitly allows /*/sb0/ listing paths, matching prior Home-Decor pass's finding). Tree built from the site-wide mega-nav (same static component documented in notes/201.md) plus each 'cat' hub page's own tile block, cross-checked per Brief Trap #1: Outdoor Lounge Furniture and Outdoor Dining & Bar Furniture both under-reported in the flat mega-nav sweep (only 2 children each visible) but their own category pages revealed the true 10 and 5 children respectively (outdoor-sofas-sectionals, outdoor-chaise-lounges, outdoor-lounge-chairs, adirondack-chairs, outdoor-benches, outdoor-accent-coffee-tables, porch-swings-hammocks, outdoor-ottomans, lawn-beach-chairs, outdoor-furniture-sets; and outdoor-dining-tables, outdoor-bistro-dining-sets, outdoor-dining-chairs, outdoor-bar-stools, patio-bar-sets) -- these were recorded as leaves under their parent grouping rows per the URL Hierarchy Rule. qty/evidence source throughout: the page's own data-tracking-metadata resultCount attribute (BlockBuilderBrowseResultCount block), the same evidence field the prior Home-Decor pass (archive c236) validated as reliable for this exact site (cross-checked there against summed children with exact matches on Outdoor Lighting and Mirrors). Two-read spot checks on Sofas and Accent+Lounge Chairs were stable across navigations. FACET-RECUT EXCLUSION: 'All Outdoor Tables' (sb0/all-outdoor-tables, resultCount 412) was dropped -- it is a roll-up aggregate spanning both Outdoor Dining Tables (118) and Outdoor Accent & Coffee Tables (227), i.e. an overlapping combined view of already-counted leaves, not a disjoint catalog node (same discipline as the Wall Art facet-recut exclusion in notes/201.md). Also dropped: outdoor-furniture-by-material (Metal/Plastic Outdoor Furniture) -- cross-cutting material facets spanning the whole outdoor furniture catalog, not a genuine second taxonomy branch. EXCLUDED (checked, not overlooked): patio-furniture-covers and outdoor-furniture-cushions (protectors/textile, not furniture); Outdoor Cooking & Tableware and Outdoor Entertaining branches (grills/tableware, not furniture); Patio Decor & Accessories branch (fire pits, planters, pillows, umbrellas -- decor/heating/textile, not furniture); toddler-bed-rails (safety hardware accessory, not a furniture piece); the entire Crib Bedding & Mattresses / Crib Sheets / Cradle & Bassinet Bedding / Baby Blankets / Crib Mattresses branch (bedding/mattresses, excluded per brief); Kids Decor & Playroom branch (Baby & Kids Rugs, Wall Art, Decorative Baskets, Play Kitchen Sets -- decor/textile/toys, not furniture). MIXED-NODE FLAG: Changing Tables & Toppers (resultCount 45) combines actual changing-table furniture with topper pad accessories in one listing node with no per-type filter/count available -- kept per the 'Beds & Mattresses' precedent (take it, flag it) rather than guessing a split. Entryway & Hallway Furniture (site's own H1 'Entry + Hall Storage') sits as its own section parallel to Living Room / Bedroom / Home Office / Kitchen & Dining under the root Furniture department, confirmed by its position in the mega-nav between the Living Room and Bedroom sections. Baby Furniture and Kids Furniture were both recorded as grouping rows (not leaves) because each has both furniture children (kept) and non-furniture children (bedding/decor/toys, dropped) mixed under one parent resultCount, so the parent number itself is not a pure furniture count.
